complexity.notes: Works but convoluted: the duplicate-value handling with pop() and index()+1 is fragile and hard to follow. Using negative index high=-1 is valid but less readable than high=len(nums2)-1. A single-pass hash map or sorting (index, value) pairs would be clearer and avoid the O(n) index() recovery entirely.
complexity.summary: Sorts a copy of the array, then uses a two-pointer scan (from both ends) to find the pair summing to target, and recovers original indices via linear index() searches with a special case for duplicate values.
